text: The Human Resources, Compensation and Labour Relations Committee on March 15, 2018, considered Item RY7.2 - Toronto Centre for the Arts - Bargaining Mandate for International Alliance of Theatrical Stage Employees (IATSE) B-173, Housekeeping.

The Board of Directors of Civic Theatres Toronto: 1. Approved the bargaining mandate for negotiations with International Alliance of Theatrical Stage Employees (IATSE) Local B-173 Housekeeping Staff at the Toronto Centre for the Arts, all as more particularly noted in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 13, 2018) from the Vice President of Operations, Civic Theatres Toronto. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 13, 2018) from the Vice President of Operations, Civic Theatres Toronto remain confidential as it pertains to labour relations or employee negotiations.
